notes: AETHERDRIFT: original 3D glider flight game in a single self-contained index.html using hand-rolled WebGL (no external dependencies). Pilot through a floating archipelago, manage height/speed energy exchange, ride thermals, avoid birds/storms, recover 9 star shards, return to beacon. Keyboard/mouse/touch supported, procedural audio, adaptive quality, reduced-motion and guarded storage. Tested in the in-app Chromium browser served over localhost: title loads with no console errors, game starts, physics/HUD verified by manually stepping frames (timer, speed ~15-17 m/s, altitude stable), pause/resume/restart verified, framebuffer sampling confirms non-blank rendering after fixing shader-link and launch-heading bugs. Screenshots were unavailable (tab not visible in headless session), and file:// cold-open was not exercised via the browser tool (requires HTTP); the file has no external requests so file:// should work. Full 9-shard playthrough to the beacon ending was verified by code inspection, not by a complete manual playthrough.
